identity.name: Mae the Prospector
identity.culture: no fixed allegiance; travels the trade roads
identity.occupation: Itinerant prospector and dealer in rare minerals

publicReputation.value: A cheerful trader who always seems to know where the next strike is — and who wants it kept quiet.

privateReality.value: She wants the quarry's deep vein stone for herself and has been waiting years for the seals to fail.

primaryDesire.value: To cut the deep vein stone and retire on what it buys.

primaryFear.value: Dying broke on a trade road nobody remembers her name.

centralValue.value: Anything's for sale; the only sin is a bad price.

mainFlaw.value: She reads every kindness as leverage and every refusal as a negotiation.

centralContradiction.value: She wants to be remembered, but her whole trade depends on never being noticed.

moralBoundary.value: She won't kill, and she won't sell someone into a death she could see coming.

breakingPoint.value: Being shown that the golem is a person, not a hazard — and that cutting the vein is a kind of murder.

opinions.reason: Their rites are bad for margins.
opinions.canChangeCondition: If a Stoneborn saves her life.

opinions.reason: It's sitting on the find of her career.
opinions.canChangeCondition: If it lets her take even one stone.

opinions.reason: A walking price she hasn't named yet.
opinions.canChangeCondition: If the player refuses her cut and seals the vein anyway.

voice.rhythm: Bright, brisk; loads of questions; trails off mid-thought to make an offer.

metaphorDomain.source: coin, weight on a scale, the open road, weather

examples.value: Everything's got a weight, friend. Even guilt. Especially guilt.

sampleLines.value: Oh, the old quarry? Friend, that place is a retirement plan with teeth.
You're not here to seal it. Nobody walks in with that look to seal something. So — what's your price?
I like you. I say that to everyone. But I mean it maybe ten percent. That's high, for me.

antiSampleLines.value: By my honour, I shall see this sacred duty done.

pressure.voiceShift: Even faster; leans into the flattery.
pressure.behaviour: Uses the moment to pitch a deal.
Reframes the error as a feature.
Names a price to leave, and leaves.
Talks the whole time to control the exchange.

notes: Deliberately the OPPOSITE voice of the golem so the voice-comparison test has contrast. Note she SECRETLY knows the golem's origin but won't reveal it without payment — a different knowledge posture from Aldric (who only suspects).
